entities.summary: Gordon Rick Dwyer is a Canadian former professional ice hockey left winger who played five seasons in the National Hockey League (NHL) for the Tampa Bay Lightning, New York Rangers and Montreal Canadiens. He currently serves as the head coach and general manager of the Newfoundland Regiment of the Quebec Maritimes Junior Hockey League (QMJHL).
